import sys, json

from run_sub import run

    out = run(doc)
    print("=== " + title)
    if 'error' in out:
        print("  ERROR:", out); return
    for r in out['runs']:
        print("  q=%s p=%s -> %s/%s final=%s trace=%s answer=%s" % (
            r['query'], r['profile'], r['rcode'], r['termination'], r['final_name'],
            r['trace'], [(a['owner'],a['type'],a['data']) for a in r['answer']]))
